_meta.purpose: Structured ad-slot definitions for the AdSlot component. Slots, sizes, div IDs, and size mappings are taken verbatim from lottery-result_upgrade_as.jsp (03-revenue-inventory). FIXED Google Ad Manager placements — the UI adapts around them; do not move/remove/merge/rename/reduce without Bala approval. No live GAM is loaded yet.

secondPublisher.note: in ads.txt (DIRECT); relationship to GAM network UNKNOWN

_meta.deviceTargeting: responsive = one slot serving both desktop & mobile via GAM size mapping (breakpoint 992px). mobile = mobile-only snippet slot. desktop/tablet reserved for future explicit-tier slots (none discovered as desktop-only). The JSP uses only two size-mapping tiers: [992,0] (desktop) and [0,0] (mobile/tablet), so 'tablet' currently resolves to the mobile tier.
_meta.lazyLoadNote: lazyLoad fields express intent for FUTURE GAM integration: request an ad only when the slot nears the viewport. Space is reserved up-front (reserveSpace) so there is NO layout shift; collapseIfEmpty stays false because placements are fixed. No googletag calls exist yet.
_meta.stickyFooterAdNote: Discovered in lottery-result_upgrade_as.jsp: a sticky, CLOSABLE footer ad (#stickyAd + #closeAdButton) wraps the bottom_large_leaderboard slot (div-gpt-ad-1695650613003-0). Modeled via container='stickyFooter' + closable=true on sp_bottom_large_leaderboard. Placeholder only, no live GAM.
_meta.rightRailPolicy: The right rail is reserved for PRODUCTION ad slots + known widgets only. Do NOT add AI teasers or new static promo banners to the rail without Bala approval. AI teasers stay in content sections and must not replace ad inventory.

sizeMappings._note: Copied verbatim from the JSP googletag.sizeMapping() builders. minViewport is [width,height]; [992,0] = desktop tier, [0,0] = mobile/tablet tier.
